Schools.Title: North Oconee High School
Schools.Description: While still attending North Oconee High School, I also dual-enrolled at the University of North Georgia. I accumulated 28 college credit hours prior to graduating Summa Cum Laude, with a focus in CTAE, and a GPA of 3.7. I was also the North Oconee High School Chess Club Secretary.

Schools.Title: University of North Georgia
Schools.Description: Through dual-enrollment, I accumulated 28 college credits prior to graduating high school. After graduation I attended the University of North Georgia for one full year until transferring to the University of Georgia. While at UNG, I was able to maintain a 4.0 GPA.

Schools.Title: University of Georgia
Schools.Major / Degree: Bachelors of Science in Computer Science
Schools.Description: After I transferred to the University of Georgia, I have continued completion of my Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and I am also working on a Certificate in Applied Data Science. I also joined the student-organized Japanese Conversation (JCC) and Mahjong Clubs. Through UGA, I was also given the opportunity to study abraod at Kyushu University in Japan, in 2024. I am now set to graduate this December with a 3.8 GPA.

Schools.Title: Kyushu University
Schools.Description: Through a partnership with my home-university, UGA, I was given the opportunity to attend Kyushu University as a foreign exchange student in the Japan in Today's World (JTW) Program. I stayed in Japan for 10 months and continued my study of Japanese langauge and culture. I now approximately have a basic "every-day level" understanding of Japanese.
